new_order_amount.meaning: remaining unfilled amount of the FOK order (newOrder.amount) after matching
new_order_amount.checkpoint: after matching engine fills tradeable portion

lot_size_in_base.meaning: market lot size in base asset for tradeable increments

taker_buy_amount.meaning: size of the FOK buy order submitted via postFillOrder

transaction_reverted.meaning: whether the FOK transaction reverted with FOKOrderNotFilled()

assumptions: Matching engine fills the tradeable portion of the FOK order before the completeness check is evaluated.
A remaining amount smaller than one lotSizeInBase is untradeable dust, as stated in as_dust_untradeable.

unresolved.description: The report does not supply an explicit numeric relation tying new_order_amount to the matching outcome; the plan uses the reported post-match remainder only as an observable symbol.
Report does not define whether the revert is triggered solely by newOrder.amount > 0 or by an additional completeness condition.

limitations: Impact i_fok_unreliable is deferred to a future claim because it is a downstream reliability consequence, not the direct revert outcome of this relation.
The plan does not model order book depth or resting order availability beyond the stated resting sell order.
Authorization and caller-eligibility of postFillOrder are not formalized because the report does not state them.
The exact source-line binding of the FOK completeness check is deferred to implementation-level analysis.
